Problems I Like Solving

Six failure modes I see over and over in B2B GTM. Flip a card to see the matching solution.

01

Drifting Without an Operating Cadence

The annual plan gets written, then ignored. Priorities drift, teams run their own plays, and nobody is accountable to the goals.

Flip for the fix

01

Install an Operating Cadence with OKRs

A seasoned OKR operator's playbook: clear objectives, measurable results, and a cadence that keeps every team pulling in the same direction.

02

Blending In with Generic Messaging

You sound like every other vendor. One message for every segment, persona, and stage, so it lands with no one.

Flip for the fix

02

Sharpen Positioning, Messaging & Brand

GTM segmentation, persona-level messaging, sharp positioning, and brand creative that make buyers instantly get why you're different.

03

Spending on the Wrong Channels

You're spread across a dozen channels with no idea which ones actually produce pipeline. Spend follows habit, not signal.

Flip for the fix

03

Calibrate the Channel Mix

Rebalance paid search, social, events (regional, conferences, digital), partners, outbound, inbound, podcasts, print, and web, weighted by what actually converts.

04

Losing Buyers in Search & AI Answers

Your buyers are searching Google and asking ChatGPT, and they're finding your competitors. Paid spend leaks, organic is flat, and AI engines don't know you exist.

Flip for the fix

04

Win Search & AI Answers

Hands-on PPC, SEO, and AEO programs that put you in front of buyers wherever they look: search engines and AI answers alike.

05

Guessing with Disconnected Data

Your data lives in ten tools that don't talk to each other. Decisions get made on anecdotes and whoever argues loudest.

Flip for the fix

05

Connect Systems & Visualize Data

Connect internal systems and visualize the data that matters, so decisions get made on evidence, not opinion.

06

Letting Customer Interest Die in Decks

Prospects tell you exactly what they want, but the ideas stall somewhere between the sales call and the roadmap. Nothing ships.

Flip for the fix

06

Prototype What Customers Ask For

Turn customer interest into working prototypes and product deliverables: fast, testable, and ready to put in front of buyers.

How I Work

Managing Teams
